第二十二章 NPC的职责-《末世入侵：我在副本里面当NPC》

听到爻雪的回答，对方指了指服装区。

因为如今才是末世初期，外面虽然食物稀缺，但衣服还是能够找到很多的，所以游戏商店的客人很少会选择在这里购买衣服，所以爻雪只是象征性地在这里放了几件衣服而已。

她没有想到面前的这个男人在进店之后竟然选择先买衣服。

“你这里还有其他款式和号码的衣服吗，面料要好，行动方便，要结实的那种衣服。”

听到男人的要求，爻雪沉吟片刻后缓缓点头道：“有的，请跟我来。”

说着，爻雪打了一个响指，一扇门的形状突然出现在两人的面前。

随着大门被缓缓打开，一个挂满了各式各样衣服的空间出现在两人的面前。

这就是游戏商店升级之后的另一个好处，将她所收集的所有物资全部都分开存放，种子放在了专门存放种子的仓库，牲畜放在专门存放牲畜的仓库，还有肉类，主食，蔬菜水果，零食等等，跟之前全部堆放在一个仓库里，而且还不能储存货物的情况完全不同。

看着爻雪的动作，男人眼神惊讶的看着她，“你是这家商店的老板？”

“嗯。”

爻雪淡淡的应了一声，然后抬脚朝着仓库里面走去。

此时仓库里面挂满了各式各样的衣服，爻雪当初几乎是将市面上能够买到的所有款式的衣服都买了一遍，现在仓库里面所展示的也不过是其中的一部分而已。

“你想要什么衣服自己选吧。”爻雪对着男人说道。

之所以带着男人直接来仓库里面挑选，是因为她也不清楚男人穿多大码的尺码，与其一件一件的试，不如让他自己挑选。

不过，男人的身高目测超过了一米九，虽然此时略显狼狈，但周身的那股矜贵淡然的气质却是怎么都掩饰不住的，此人一看就是她在末世之前绝对接触不到的人。

男人很快便挑选好了衣服，然后跟着爻雪离开了仓库。

来到柜台结账时，男人将身后的背包解下来，拉开拉链，将里面的东西一股脑全部倒了出来，其中，除了几十枚晶核之外，竟然还有各种宝石和玉石首饰。

After hearing Yaoxue's answer, the other party pointed to the clothing area.

Because it is now the beginning of the end of the world, although food is scarce outside, there are still a lot of clothes. Therefore, customers in the game store rarely choose to buy clothes here, so Yaoxue just put a few clothes here symbolically.

She didn't expect that the man in front of her would choose to buy clothes first after entering the store.

"Do you have any other styles and sizes of clothes here? The fabric should be good, easy to move, and strong."

Hearing the man's request, Yaoxue pondered for a moment and then slowly nodded and said: "Yes, please come with me."

As he spoke, Yaoxue snapped her fingers, and the shape of a door suddenly appeared in front of the two of them.

As the door was slowly opened, a space filled with all kinds of clothes appeared in front of them.

This is another benefit after upgrading the game store. All the materials she collects are stored separately. The seeds are placed in a warehouse dedicated to storing seeds. The livestock are placed in a warehouse dedicated to storing livestock. There are also meat, staple food, fruits and vegetables, snacks, etc. It is completely different from the previous situation where they were all piled in one warehouse and could not store goods.

Looking at Yaoxue's movements, the man looked at her in surprise, "Are you the owner of this store?"

"Yeah."

Yaoxue responded lightly, then walked towards the warehouse.

At this time, the warehouse was filled with all kinds of clothes. Yaoxue had bought almost all the styles of clothes that could be bought on the market, and now what was displayed in the warehouse was only a part of them.

"Choose what clothes you want." Yaoxue said to the man.

The reason why she took the man directly to the warehouse to choose is because she didn't know what size the man wore. Instead of trying them on one by one, it was better to let him choose by himself.

However, the man's height was estimated to be over 1.9 meters tall. Although he looked a little embarrassed at this time, the noble and indifferent temperament around him could not be concealed. At first glance, this man was someone she would never be able to come into contact with before the end of the world.

The man quickly picked out his clothes and followed Yao Xue out of the warehouse.

When he came to the counter to check out, the man took off the backpack behind him, opened the zipper, and poured out all the contents. In addition to dozens of crystal nuclei, there were also various gems and jade jewelry.
